prompt: This photorealistic photo captures a bustling bakery interior bathed in warm, natural morning light streaming through large glass windows. In the center, a baker wearing a white apron carefully places a tray of golden croissants onto a wooden counter. To the left, a customer in a blue coat holds out a ceramic mug while another person pours steaming coffee into it from a silver pot. On the right, a child in a striped shirt reaches for a chocolate donut displayed in a glass case. Beside the child, a woman in a green scarf looks down at her phone, leaning slightly against the display cabinet. In the foreground, a basket of fresh baguettes sits next to a jar of honey with a wooden dipper resting inside. Behind the counter, shelves are stacked with various pastries, including muffins and tarts. A cat sleeps peacefully on a high shelf in the background, curled up near a stack of flour bags. The lighting highlights the textures of the crusty bread and the smooth ceramic tiles, creating a cozy and inviting atmosphere that emphasizes the freshness of the baked goods and the quiet interactions of the patrons.
